messages:
sara (support): 11:13 AM - getting multiple reports: customers seeing 401 / permission_denied when calling /v1/requests. Starting to aggregate.
customer-jordan: seeing: "error: "permission_denied", "reason":"missing_scope:inference.invoke"" on every request since ~11:05
sara (support): thanks. Any recent changes to auth? keys? rotates?
ops-bot: Scheduled job 'rotate-keys' started at 11:04:37 by automation.
kevin (oncall-sre): @miko can you confirm rotate-keys didn't touch live token scopes? It should only rewrap keys.
miko (platform): checking logs... hmm. rotate-keys did trigger a PRUNE step in pre-prod migration that accidentally ran in prod due to env var mismatch. The prune task removed unused scopes from cached tokens. :grimacing:
kevin (oncall-sre): that would explain missing inference.invoke. Are tokens permanently mutated or cache-only?
miko (platform): looks like auth-store update applied patch that trimmed scope arrays for 3.2M tokens. This is an update to persisted token records.
sara (support): we've got customers in enterprise complaining loudly. How many orgs affected?
miko (platform): initial query shows ~120 orgs, most with long-lived API keys. We're pulling a list now.
diana (product): need communication plan and mitigation ASAP. Billing impact? customers can't call API.
billing-team: holding on billing changes, but will pause overage charges if we classify outage.
kevin (oncall-sre): mitigation plan: 1) stop prune job (done), 2) restore token records from backup snapshot at 11:03 (pre-prune), 3) re-run minimal migration with scope-preserve flag, 4) re-issue ephemeral keys to high-severity customers.
miko (platform): step 2 restore in progress. Rolling restore into shard-3 first to validate, then rest. ETA ~28m.
kevin (oncall-sre): can we provide temporary workaround? e.g., allow fallback: if token lacks inference.invoke, check linked service account perms.
sara (support): telling customers to retry; giving context and ETA. Sample message: "We're investigating an auth-side issue causing permission_denied errors for API keys. Working on restore; ETA ~30m."
customer-jordan: appreciate the update. We're stuck in prod pipelines.
deploy-bot: rollbacks not applicable because this change is DB-level. No service binary rollback.
kevin (oncall-sre): patch we need: prevent prune from executing in prod unless env == prod-allow-prune. Also add safe-guard that prune only affects tokens with last-used beyond 1y and zero billing.
miko (platform): agreed. I'll open a PR w/ tests. Also exporting list of affected token ids to notify customers and force rotate keys if needed.
diana (product): prioritize high-usage orgs for manual key re-issues.
ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 by automonitor at 11:22.
sara (support): compiling list of customers impacted; will send to legal/comms.
kevin (oncall-sre): restore complete for 80% shards. Observability shows errors per minute dropping from 420 to 40.
miko (platform): remaining shards restoring; running verification script: `SELECT count(*) FROM tokens WHERE scopes NOT LIKE '%inference.invoke%';`
kevin (oncall-sre): keep monitoring. Post-mortem owners: miko (platform) for root cause and remediation, kevin for runbook changes, sara for customer comms.
sara (support): sending customer update: "We restored token records to pre-rotation state; please retry. If you still see 401s, open support thread and include your org id."
customer-jordan: 1:52 PM - calls are succeeding now, thanks. We'll need formal RCA.
kevin (oncall-sre): noted. Next steps: ticket for adding integration test for rotate-keys job to block accidental prune; include pre-release kill-switch.
miko (platform): PR #4921 opened. Patch includes env guard + audit trail. Will request expedited review.
diana (product): we'll prepare a postmortem doc and customer-facing timeline. Assigning reviewers.
sara (support): closing thread for now; will reopen if new regressions found. :white_check_mark:
